title: 教育与技术应用词汇
goal: 能选用教育与技术应用词汇并区分工具功能和学习结果。

points.label: 选用教育与技术应用的准确词汇
区分工具功能与实际学习结果

sources.title: 雅思 IELTS Academic：课表
sources.used: 教育与技术应用词汇的内容和教学规格

body.p: 讨论教育技术时，要分清工具提供的功能和学习者实际得到的结果。学习效果还取决于学习活动和使用条件。

body.box: A recording allows students to replay a lesson; learning depends on how they use it.

body.p: 重复播放是录播的功能。能不能学会，取决于学习者怎样使用录播。

body.box: A college makes recordings of practical demonstrations available through its learning platform. Students can replay a demonstration before attempting the procedure themselves. This function may help them review the order of the steps, but replaying a video does not establish that a student can perform the task. A teacher can observe practice and give feedback on mistakes. The recording therefore supports preparation, while the observed activity provides evidence of practical performance.

body.p: 重播示范是工具的功能，帮助复习步骤是它可能起的作用。学生能否完成操作，要靠教师观察实际练习来判断。

groups.fill: Many students attend lessons at a local college. A schol{arship} covers fe{es} for lear{ners} who hold gra{nts}. Before course enro{lment}, each appl{icant} checks eligi{bility} with st{aff}. The plat{form} supports revi{sion}. Students can use the materials at a time that fits their work and family responsibilities. The college also offers face-to-face support to those who need help with their studies. These arrangements give adults different ways to prepare for classes and to discuss their work with a tutor.

groups.text: A college introduces an online platform for a writing course. Students can upload drafts and receive comments from a tutor. The platform also stores earlier versions, so students can compare a revised draft with the original. These functions make feedback and comparison available outside the classroom. They do not show by themselves that every student has improved. A student may read the comments without changing the text, or may revise a sentence while leaving its meaning unclear. To assess progress, the tutor can compare the drafts against the same criteria and discuss the reasons for changes with the student. Internet access remains necessary for using the platform away from college. For students with an unreliable connection, the college provides computers on campus. The tool thus offers a way to exchange work and comments, while evidence of improvement comes from the quality of the writing and the student's use of feedback.

items.stem: What does upload mean in this context?
options: Send a draft to the online platform.
Receive comments on a draft from a tutor.
Store an earlier version of a draft.
Compare a revised draft with the original.
items.why: upload drafts 指学生把草稿发到平台上，即第一项。第二项是上传之后的事：学生收到教师的评语。

items.stem: Which is a function of the platform?
options: Guaranteeing that all students improve their writing.
Storing earlier versions for comparison with revisions.
Assessing each student's progress against the same criteria.
Providing every student with a reliable home connection.
items.why: The platform also stores earlier versions 是平台的功能，学生可借此比较草稿，即第二项。第三项按同一标准评判进展是教师做的事。

items.stem: What is feedback in the passage?
options: The online connection used to upload a draft.
The campus computers used to reach the platform.
Comments from a tutor on a student's work.
The first version of a student's assignment.
items.why: comments from a tutor 是教师对作业的反馈。

items.stem: What could provide evidence of progress?
options: Comments that a student reads but does not use.
A revision that leaves the meaning unclear.
The number of earlier versions stored by the platform.
A comparison of drafts using the same criteria.
items.why: the tutor can compare the drafts against the same criteria 说明进展要靠按同一标准比较草稿来判断，即第四项。第三项只说明平台存了几个版本，不说明写作有没有进步。

options: They offer access when a home connection is unreliable.
They let tutors compare drafts against the same criteria.
They store earlier versions of each student's draft.
They make internet access unnecessary for the platform.
items.why: For students with an unreliable connection, the college provides computers on campus：网络不稳定的学生可以在校园电脑上使用平台，即第一项。

groups.fill: A school supports a new language course. Each lea{rner} receives acc{ess} to vid{eos} for revi{sion}. A plat{form} stores assig{nments} and feed{back} from tut{ors}. Students upl{oad} completed wo{rk}. The school provides computers for students who cannot use a suitable device at home. This arrangement gives the whole class a way to reach the materials. Teachers can discuss the assignments in person as well as through the platform, so online comments form one part of the support available.

groups.text: A college has introduced recorded demonstrations for a practical course. Students can replay a video before attempting a procedure and pause it to examine individual steps. This feature allows them to review the sequence at their own pace. However, the ability to replay a demonstration does not establish whether a student can carry out the procedure accurately. The college therefore retains supervised practice sessions. During these sessions, a tutor observes each student and provides feedback on errors. The tutor can compare later performance with earlier attempts to assess progress. Recordings may also increase access for students who miss a demonstration, provided that they have a suitable device and connection. The college makes computers available on campus for those without equipment at home. The recordings offer a resource for preparation, while the supervised task supplies evidence of practical performance. How much students benefit depends on their use of both the recording and the opportunity to practise.

items.stem: What does replay mean in the passage?
options: Watch the recorded demonstration again.
Pause the video to examine one step.
Repeat the procedure in a supervised session.
Observe a student carrying out the procedure.
items.why: replay a video 指把录像再放一遍，即第一项。第三项是把操作再做一遍，不是再看录像。

items.stem: Which is a function of the recording?
options: Proving that each student can perform every step accurately.
Allowing students to pause and review individual steps.
Guaranteeing that no tutor needs to observe practice.
Providing a suitable home connection for every student.
items.why: pause it to examine individual steps 是录像提供的功能。

options: The recording that students replay before practice.
The device students use to access the demonstration.
Information given to students about their errors.
A comparison of later attempts with earlier ones.
items.why: provides feedback on errors 指教师向学生指出错误，即第三项。第四项是教师判断进展的做法，不是反馈本身。

items.stem: What provides evidence of practical performance?
options: The number of times the video can be paused.
The fact that a demonstration has been recorded.
The presence of a computer on the college campus.
The tutor's observation of the supervised task.
items.why: observes each student 和 supervised task supplies evidence 指向现场观察。

items.stem: Which condition affects access to the recordings?
options: A suitable device and connection are available.
Students have attended the original demonstration.
A tutor is present to observe each student.
Students practise the procedure beforehand.
items.why: provided that they have a suitable device and connection 指出使用录像的条件，即第一项。
